Stock market news | Tata Sons Board Postponed to Nov 30 Over Listing Objections

Tata Sons postponed its board meeting to 30 November. The change follows a letter from Noel Tata raising concerns that the agenda was shared only four days before, breaching the required seven-day notice. The agenda includes discussion on the mandatory listing of Tata Sons and proposals to keep the holding company private, highlighting growing differences within the Tata group over the IPO plan.
